cards.name: Fulfill the Contract
text: Choose an Adversary Group. You get +1 Recruit for each Adversary in your Victory Pile from that Adversary Group.

cards.name: Specialist Assassin
text: Choose an Adversary. It gets -1 Attack for each Adversary in your Victory Pile from that Adversary Group.

cards.name: Perfect Aim
text: You get +5 Attack for each Commander Tactic in your Victory Pile.

cards.name: Brilliant Research
text: [Tech]: When you draw a new hand of cards at the end of this turn, draw an extra card.

cards.name: Eighth Time's a Charm
text: If this is the eighth card you played this turn, you get +2 Attack.
If at first you don't succeed...

cards.name: Octo-Pulverize
text: Discard cards from the top of your deck until your deck runs out or you have discarded 8 cards (don't shuffle). Then you get +1 Attack for each card you discarded this turn.

cards.name: Electroshock Therapy
text: Reveal the top card of your deck. You may KO it.
"I'm not really all that shocked to see you go"

cards.name: Shocking Robbery
text: You get +3 Attack usable only against Adversaries in the Bank.
[Ranged]: Instead you may get +3 Attack usable only against the Commander.

cards.name: Supercharge
text: You get +1 Attack for each card you discarded this turn.

cards.name: Anti-Matter
text: All Adversaries and the Commander get -1 Attack this turn.
Sinister Six, Sinister Six: Same Effect

cards.name: Enchant the Senses
text: [Ranged]: Whenever you defeat an Adversary this turn, you gain a New Recruit.

cards.name: Soul Sacrifice
text: You may KO a card from your hand or discard pile. You get +Recruit equal to that card's Cost.

cards.name: Irresistible Bribe
text: Choose an Adversary. You can spend any combination of Recruit and Attack to fight that Adversary this turn.
[Covert], [Covert]: You can also spend any combination of Recruit and Attack to fight the Commander this turn.

cards.name: Unending Anguish
text: Foes of Asgard: Then put Unending Anguish on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Goblin Glider
text: When you play or Dodge with this card, another HYDRA Ally in your hand gains Dodge this turn.

cards.name: Pumpkin Bombs
text: If you discarded any cards this turn, you get +2 Attack.

cards.name: Unstable Kidnapper
text: If you discarded any cards this turn, kidnap a Bystander.

cards.name: Experimental Goblin Serum
text: Return from your discard pile to your hand all the cards you discarded this turn.

cards.name: Crimson Gem of Cyttorak
text: [Strength]: Each other player reveals the top card of their deck, and if it costs 1, 2, or 3, discards it. You get +1 Recruit for each card discarded this way.

cards.name: Size Matters
text: You get +1 Attack for each other card you played this turn that costs 4 or more.

cards.name: Runaway Train
text: To play this card, you must discard a card from your hand.

cards.name: Unstoppable Force
text: Choose one: Each player KOs two cards from their hand, or each player KOs two cards from their discard pile. Then you get +1 Attack for each non-grey Ally KO'd this turn.

cards.name: Pull the Strings
text: Whenever a card effect causes you to gain a New Recruit this turn, put that New Recruit into your hand. Gain a New Recruit.

cards.name: Recruitment Day
text: "Anyone else want to punch Daredevil in the face?"

cards.name: Import Illegal Weapons
text: You get +1 Attack for each New Recruit you played this turn.

cards.name: Endless Underlings
text: Crime Syndicate, Crime Syndicate: If you would return a New Recruit to the New Recruit Stack this turn, put it on the bottom of your deck instead.

cards.name: Ceaseless Tracker
text: Sometimes it's not best to go it alone.

cards.name: Corner the Prey
text: Choose an Adversary. If there are no empty city spaces adjacent to that Adversary, it gets -1 Attack this turn.

cards.name: Hunt Down
text: Choose an Adversary and a direction. Move that Adversary as many adjacent, empty spaces as you can in that direction. You get +1 Attack for each space it moved.

cards.name: He's the Best Around
text: You get +Attack equal to the Cost of the highest-cost Ally in the Lair.
No one's gonna ever keep him down.

cards.name: All Humans Are Expendable
text: [Covert]: You may KO a card from your hand or discard pile. If you do, gain a New Recruit.

cards.name: Illusionary Bindings
text: [Ranged]: Each other player reveals a [Ranged] Ally or gains a Bindings. If any number of players gained a Bindings this way, you get +1 Recruit.

cards.name: Father of Lies
text: Look at the top two cards of another player's deck. Without revealing those cards, call one of them "Good" and one "Bad." That player puts one of those cards into their discard pile and the other into your discard pile.

cards.name: God of Mischief
text: Each player reveals a Foes of Asgard Ally or reveals their hand. For each player that revealed their hand, you may swap a card from that hand with a card in the Lair of the same cost.

cards.name: Magnetic Levitation
text: You may choose a Bindings from your hand or discard pile and have another player gain that Bindings. If you do, you get +2 Attack.

cards.name: Mutants Will Rule
text: [Strength]: Choose a player. That player reveals a Brotherhood Ally or gains a Bindings. If a Bindings is gained this way, you get +1 Recruit.

cards.name: Weapons from Scrap Metal
text: If you discarded any cards this turn, draw a card.
One person's trash is another person's high velocity projectile weapon.

cards.name: Master of Magnetism
text: Brotherhood: For each other Brotherhood Ally you played this turn, choose a player to gain a Bindings. Then you get +2 Attack for each Bindings gained this turn.

cards.name: Psychedelic Mist
text: Mysterio is at his best when the mist rolls in.

cards.name: Shifting Decoy
text: Put a card from the lair on the bottom of the Ally Deck. If that card had a Recruit icon, you get +2 Recruit. If that card had an Attack icon, you get +2 Attack.

cards.name: Holographic Illusion
text: You get +1 Attack for each color of Ally in the Lair.

cards.name: False Reflection
text: Put a card from the Lair on the bottom of the Ally Deck. You get +Recruit equal to that card's printed Recruit and +Attack equal to its printed Attack.
Sinister Six: Then, for each other Sinister Six Ally you played this turn, do the same effect. (Use a different Ally from the Lair each time.)

cards.name: Hidden Weapons
text: Mystique is definitely a dual threat.

cards.name: Show Your True Colors
text: As you play this card, you may choose a class. This card is that class instead of [Covert] this turn.

cards.name: Turn the Tide
text: Reveal the top card of the Ally Deck. You may play a copy of that card this turn. When you do, put that card on the bottom of the Ally Deck.

cards.name: Spy Games
text: Reveal the top five cards of the Ally Deck. You get +Attack equal to their total printed Attack. Then put them back in any order.

cards.name: Leap of the Tiger
text: Reveal the top card of your deck, then put it back on top of your deck or into your discard pile. If that card was an [Instinct] Ally, you get +2 Attack.

cards.name: Take One for the Team
text: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Brotherhood Ally, you may draw it. Otherwise, you may KO it.

cards.name: Stealthy Predator
text: Reveal the top three cards of your deck. Draw one of them, discard one, and put the other back on top of your deck.

cards.name: Upper Hand
text: Each player reveals a [Instinct] Ally or reveals the top card of their deck. Choose any number of those revealed top cards to be KO'd.
[Instinct]: You get +1 Attack for each card KO'd this turn.

cards.name: Army of Ultrons
text: Reveal a HYDRA card from your hand. That card is [Tech] instead of its normal color this turn.

cards.name: Encephalo-Ray
text: [Tech]: You get +1 Attack for each other [Tech] Ally you played this turn.

cards.name: Genetic Experimentation
text: [Tech]: Kidnap a Bystander for each other [Tech] Ally you played this turn.

cards.name: Molecular Rearrangement
text: Each other player reveals a [Tech] Ally or discards their hand. Each player who discarded their hand this way draws 5 cards.
[Tech]: You get +3 Attack for each Ally discarded this way that costs 7 Cost or more.

cards.name: Devour
text: You may KO a Bystander from your Victory Pile. If you do, you get +2 Attack.

cards.name: Horrify the Populace
text: Each Adversary with a 4 Attack or more guards a Bystander.

cards.name: Ravenous Greed
text: Each other player reveals an [Instinct] Ally or KOs a Bystander from their Victory Pile.
[Instinct]: Kidnap all Bystanders that were KO'd this turn. Then you get +1 Recruit for each Bystander you kidnapped this turn.

cards.name: Captain America
text: Ambush: Each player reveals three colors of Allies or gains a Bindings. (Grey is a color.)
Fight: Same effect. Captain America gets +1 Attack for each color of Ally in the Lair.

cards.name: Iron Man
text: Ambush: Each player reveals a [Tech] Ally or gains a Bindings.

cards.name: Thor
text: Ambush: KO each Ally from the Lair that costs 7 Cost or more.

cards.name: Daredevil
text: Fight: The next Ally you recruit this turn goes on top of your deck.
Overrun: Each player reveals the top card of their deck and if it costs 1 Cost or more, discards it.

cards.name: Iron Fist
text: To fight Iron Fist, you must also reveal three Allies with different costs.

cards.name: Namor, The Sub-Mariner
text: Ambush: If any other Defenders Adversaries are in the city, each player gains a Bindings.

cards.name: Luke Cage
text: Fight: Each player reveals the top three cards of their deck. You choose which players discard them and which players put them back on top in the order of their choice.

cards.name: Black Panther
text: Fight: Each player draws a card.

cards.name: Elektra
text: Fight: KO one of your Allies. Then KO a Bindings from your hand or discard pile.

cards.name: Punisher
text: Fight: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it costs 0 Cost, KO it.
Overrun: Each player reveals the top card of their deck and if it costs 1 Cost or more, KOs it.

cards.name: Ghost Rider
text: Fight: You may KO another Adversary from your Victory Pile. If you do, you get +3 Recruit.
Overrun: Each player may KO an Adversary from their Victory Pile. Any player who does not do so gains a Bindings.

cards.name: Black Cat
text: Fight: Each player reveals the top card of their deck. Choose any number of those cards to be discarded.

cards.name: Firestar
text: Fight: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it has a Recruit icon, KO it.
Overrun: Each player reveals the top card of their deck, and if it has an Attack icon, KO it.

cards.name: Moon Knight
text: Fight: KO one of your Allies. Then, if you fought Moon Knight on the Rooftops, KO another of your Allies.

cards.name: Spider-Man
text: Fight: Reveal the top card of the Adversary Deck. If that card is worth 2 Victory Points or less, play it. If you play a card from the Adversary Deck this way, put Spider-Man back on top of the Adversary Deck.
Overrun: Each player gains a Bindings.

cards.name: Havok
text: Ambush: Each player who does not reveal a [Ranged] Ally discards two cards, then draws a card.

cards.name: Rogue
text: Fight: Each other player discards the top card of their deck. Play a copy of one of those Allies.

cards.name: Scarlet Witch
text: Fight: Reveal the top three cards of your deck. Put any that have odd-numbered costs into your hand and discard the rest. (0 is even.)

cards.name: Wolverine
text: Wolverine gets +1 Attack for each card you've drawn this turn.
Overrun: Each player reveals an [Instinct] Ally or gains a Bindings. Then shuffle Wolverine back into the Adversary deck.

cards.name: Colossus
text: Fight: You may KO a Bindings from your hand or discard pile. If you don't, each other player gains a Bindings.

cards.name: Nightcrawler
text: Fight: Choose an Ally you played this turn. When you draw a new hand of cards at the end of this turn, add that Ally to your new hand as an extra card.

cards.name: Storm
text: Ambush: (After Storm enters the city.) Move Storm to the Rooftops. If another Adversary is already there, swap them.
Fight: If you fight Storm on the Rooftops, each other player gains a Bindings.

cards.name: Angel
text: Fight: Draws two cards, then discard a card.

cards.name: Iceman
text: Fight: Draw a card for each [Ranged] Ally you played this turn.

cards.name: Jean Grey
text: Ambush: Jean Grey guards a Bystander for each Adversary in the city with X-Treme Attack (including Jean).
Fight: You get +1 Recruit for each Bystander you kidnapped this turn.

cards.name: Beast
text: Fight: KO one of your Allies. Then KO another of your Allies if there are any other Adversaries in the city with X-Treme Attack.

cards.name: Cyclops
text: X-Treme Attack. To Fight Cyclops, you must also discard a card.
Overrun: Each player reveals a Brotherhood Ally or discards a card.

henchmen.name: Multiple Man
text: Fight: KO one of your Allies for each other Multiple Man in your Victory Pile.

henchmen.name: S.H.I.E.L.D. Assault Squad
text: Fight: Discard the top card of your deck. Then KO an Ally from your discard pile.

masterminds.name: Dr. Strange
text: Command Strike: Reveal the top three cards of the Adversary Deck. Put the Adversary you revealed with the highest printed Attack on top of that deck. Then play a Plot Twist from among the cards you revealed. Then put the rest of those cards on the bottom of that deck in random order.

tactics.name: Book of the Vishanti
text: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Covert] Ally or discards all the cards in their hand, then draws as many cards as they discarded.

tactics.name: Crimson Bands of Cyttorak
text: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand, then gains a Bindings for each non-grey Ally that player has.

tactics.name: Eye of Agamotto
text: Fight: Reveal cards from the Ally Deck equal to the number of players. Put one of those cards into each player's discard pile.

tactics.name: Winds of Watoomb
text: Fight: After you draw a new hand of cards at the end of this turn, each player simultaneously passes a non-grey Ally from their hand to the hand of the player on their left.

masterminds.name: Nick Fury
text: Command Strike: Stack this Strike next to Nick Fury. Then demolish each player once for each Strike stacked here.

tactics.name: Bounty on Fury's Head
text: Fight: KO any number of your Hydra Allies. For each Ally you KO'd this way, you may gain a Madame HYDRA.

tactics.name: Purge Hydra
text: Fight: Each other player reveals their hand and discards two Hydra Allies.

tactics.name: The Avengers Initiative
text: Fight: Each other player reveals a [Tech] Ally or chooses an Avengers Adversary from their Victory Pile and it enters the Bridge.

tactics.name: Total Fury
text: Fight: Defeat an Adversary whose Attack is less than the number of Hydra Allies in the KO pile.

masterminds.name: Odin
text: Odin gets +1 Attack for each Asgardian Warrior in the city and in the Overrun Pile.
Command Strike: Each player puts an Asgardian Warrior from their Victory Pile into an empty city space. Any player who cannot do so gains a Bindings.

tactics.name: Divine Justice
text: Fight: Each other player with a Bindings in their discard pile gains another Bindings.

tactics.name: Might of Valhalla
text: Fight: Draw a card for each Asgardian Warrior in your Victory Pile.

tactics.name: Riches of Asgard
text: Fight: You get +1 Recruit for each Asgardian Warrior in your Victory Pile.

tactics.name: Ride of the Valkyries
text: Fight: Each other player reveals a Foes of Asgard Ally or discards a card for each Asgardian Warrior in the Overrun Pile.

masterminds.name: Professor X
text: Command Strike: Choose the two highest-cost Allies in the Lair. Stack them next to Professor X as "Telepathic Pawns." Professor X gets +1 Attack for each Ally stacked next to him. Players can recrut the top Ally in the stack next to Professor X.

tactics.name: Cerebro Device
text: Fight: Reveal the top three cards of the Adversary Deck. Play any Adversaries you revealed that have "X-Treme Attack". Put the rest back in random order.

tactics.name: Mental Dominance
text: Fight: Stack the top three cards of the Ally Deck next to Professor X in random order as "Telepathic Pawns."

tactics.name: Mightiest Mutant Mind
text: Fight: Each other player reveals a Brotherhood Ally or stacks a non-grey Ally from their hand next to Professor X as a "Telepathic Pawn."

tactics.name: Telepathic Imprisonment
text: Fight: Each other player reveals a Brotherhood Ally or gains a Bindings.

schemes.name: Build an Underground MegaVault Prison
text: Setup: 8 Twists. The Bindings stack holds 5 Bindings per player.
Twist: If there is an Adversary in the Sewers, each player gains a Bindings. Otherwise, reveal the top card of the Adversary Deck. If that card is an Adversary, it enters the Sewers.
Good Wins: When the Bindings stack runs out.

schemes.name: Cage Villains in Power-Suppressing Cells
text: Setup: 8 Twists. Stack 2 Cops per player next to this Plot.

Twist: Each player returns all Cops from their Victory Pile to the Cop Stack. Then each player puts a non-grey Ally from their hand in front of them. Put a Cop from the Cop Stack on top of each of those Allies.
Special Rules: You can fight any Cop on top of Allies. If you do, the player of your choice gains that Ally.
Good Wins: When a Twist must put out a Cop, but the Cop Stack is already empty.

schemes.name: Crown Thor King of Asgard
text: Setup: 8 Twists. Put the Thor Adversary next to this Plot.
Twist: If Thor is in the city, he overruns. Otherwise, Thor enters the Bridge from wherever he is, and Thor guards 3 Bystanders.
Special Rules: Whenever Thor overruns, stack a Plot Twist from the KO pile next to this Plot as a "Triumph of Asgard."
Good Wins: When there are 3 Triumphs of Asgard next to this Plot.

schemes.name: Crush HYDRA
text: Twists 1-7: Each Adversary in the city captures a New Recruit, or if there are no more New Recruits, a Madame HYDRA.
Twist 8: Put all captured Allies from the city into the Overrun Pile.
Special Rules: An Adversary gets +1 Attack for each Ally it has captured. When you fight that Adversary, gain those Allies.
Good Wins: When there are 11 Allies in the Overrun Pile.

schemes.name: Graduation at Xavier's X-Academy
text: Setup: 8 Twists. Stack 8 Bystanders next to this Plot as "Young Mutants."
Twist: Put a Bystander from next to this Plot into the Overrun Pile.
Good Wins: When there are 8 Bystanders in the Overrun Pile.

schemes.name: Infiltrate the Lair with Spies
text: Setup: 8 Twists, Stack 21 Bystanders next to this Plot as "Infiltrating Spies."
Twist: Put all Bystanders from the Lair into the Overrun pile. Then put a Bystander from next to this Plot into each Lair space under the Bridge, Streets, and Sewers.
Special Rules: When you recruit an Ally, kidnap any Bystander in that Lair space. When an Ally leaves the Lair in any other way, put any Bystander from that Lair space into the Overrun Pile.
Good Wins: When there are 12 Bystanders in the Overrun Pile.

schemes.name: Mass Produce War Machine Armor
text: Setup: 8 Twists, Include 10 S.H.I.E.L.D. Assault Squads as one of the Backup Adversary groups.
Twist: Stack this Twist next to the Plot as "War Machine Technology." An Assault Squad from the current player's Victory Pile enters the Bridge.
Special Rules: Assault Squads get +1 Attack for each War Machine Technology next to the Plot.
Good Wins: When there are 3 Assault Squads in the Overrun Pile.

schemes.name: Resurrect Heroes with Norn Stones
text: Twists 1-6: An Adversary from the current player's Victory Pile enters the Bridge. Then play the top card of the Adversary Deck.
Twists 7-8: Each player puts an Adversary from their Victory Pile into the Overrun Pile.
Good Wins: When there are 3 Adversaries per player in the Overrun Pile.
schemes.deck_name: Resurrect Heroes With The Norn Stones
